sources.title: Buccaneers at Bengals: Final Injury Report for Week 1
sources.description: The Tampa Bay Buccaneers will enter Sunday’s season opener against the Cincinnati Bengals with three players listed as doubtful and another questionable on the final injury report. Wide receiver Jalen McMillan (knee), offensive tackle Justin Skule (oblique) and running back Sean Tucker (hamstring) are doubtful after all three were limited during Friday’s practice.
